## About
Kingsbridge Animal Clinic sits on Belt Line Road in Garland, and it's known for our caring and thorough veterinarian, Dr. Charles A. Proshek. Folks just call him Dr. Charlie. He was born and raised in Minnesota, moved to Texas, graduated from Texas A&M, and worked in both small and large animal practices before settling in Garland. He opened the clinic on Valentine's Day.
Dr. Charlie's own dogs came to him the way a lot of pets find their people. Beau was surrendered to the clinic as a puppy and ended up at home with him. Brother was found wandering in the backwoods of Louisiana, covered in fleas and ticks, and got all the care and love he needed in his forever home.
Dr. Charlie is best known for being a patient doctor and for the care he gives every patient. Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 410 Google reviews, and we'd love for you to come be a part of our Kingsbridge Family.

## Services
- Head to Tail Exams: A careful look at your pet from nose to tail.
- Wellness Examinations: Regular checkups to keep your pet healthy year to year.
- Vaccinations and Testing: Keeping your pet's shots and tests up to date.
- Surgery: From sterilization surgeries and minor procedures to major surgeries.
- Preanesthetic Blood Panels: Bloodwork before anesthesia, run through our diagnostic lab.
- Comprehensive Blood Panels: A fuller picture of your pet's health from our diagnostic lab.
- Home Delivery: Medications sent straight to your home, with Auto-Ship programs so they arrive on time, just when you need them.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes. Please call us to set up an appointment before you come in.

Q: Are your hours different on the last Wednesday of the month?
A: Yes. On the last Wednesday of the month we're open 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM for RX pick up and tech appointments only. There's no DVM on-site that day.

Q: Who do I call after hours?
A: For after-hours care, we point you to Dallas Animal Urgent Care at (972) 910-2890, or to MedVet Richardson or MedVet Dallas.

Q: Can I ask a medical question by email?
A: We can't give medical advice via email. If you need help right away, please give us a call.

Q: Do you take Care Credit?
A: Yes, you can pay with Care Credit through our website.
